request: A snap together case for a Raspberry Pi 5, open on top, with every port, the power button and the microSD slot reachable.

body_sources.w: Raspberry Pi 5 STEP RP-010083 (rpi-5b_no_graphics.step), overall bounding box x -0.45 to 88.05. Cross check, mechanical drawing https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rpi5/raspberry-pi-5-mechanical-drawing.pdf: board '85', left edge part overhang '0.45', Ethernet overhang '3' (sum 88.45)
body_sources.d: Raspberry Pi 5 STEP RP-010083, overall bounding box y -1.63 (micro HDMI shells past the front edge) to 56.0. Board depth '56' on the mechanical drawing; the 1.63 front overhang is not on the drawing
body_sources.h: Raspberry Pi 5 STEP RP-010083, overall bounding box z -1.45 (underside part) to 17.526 (USB stack top). The mechanical drawing publishes no overall height
body_sources.corner_r: no radius published (the Pi 5 drawing draws rounded board corners with no label); 0 is the enclosing box, which here includes the port overhangs

features.name: usb_c_power
features.source: u: drawing https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rpi5/raspberry-pi-5-mechanical-drawing.pdf front edge '11.2' from the left board edge, plus 0.45 frame offset. v and size: STEP RP-010083 body centered at x 11.20, bbox z 0.336 to 4.596, width 8.94. Drawing side view '3.2' (connector top above PCB top) vs STEP 3.29

features.name: micro_hdmi_0
features.source: u: drawing front edge '25.8' from the left board edge, plus 0.45 offset. v and size: STEP RP-010083 shell centered at x 25.80, bbox z 0.235 to 4.682, width 7.19. Drawing side view '3.4' (connector top above PCB top) vs STEP 3.376

features.name: micro_hdmi_1
features.source: u: drawing front edge '39.2' from the left board edge, plus 0.45 offset. v and size: STEP RP-010083 shell centered at x 39.20, bbox z 0.235 to 4.682, width 7.19

features.name: ethernet
features.source: u: drawing right edge '10.2' from the front board edge, plus 1.63 offset. v and size: STEP RP-010083 jack bbox y 2.285 to 18.215 (center 10.25), z -0.664 to 14.636 (includes its through pins)

features.name: usb_stack_a
features.source: u: drawing right edge '29.1' from the front board edge, plus 1.63 offset. v and size: STEP RP-010083 dual USB-A body bbox y 21.75 to 36.25 (center 29.0), z -0.164 to 17.526

features.name: usb_stack_b
features.source: u: drawing right edge '47' from the front board edge, plus 1.63 offset. v and size: STEP RP-010083 dual USB-A body bbox y 39.75 to 54.25 (center 47.0), z -0.166 to 17.361

features.name: power_button
features.source: y: drawing left edge '18.4' from the front board edge (u = 57.63 - (18.4 + 1.63)); the '0.45' overhang on the drawing is this part. v and size: STEP RP-010083 body bbox x -0.45 to 0.6, y 17.4 to 19.4, z 2.036 to 4.036. Naming it the power button is mine: the drawing does not label it

features.name: status_led
features.source: y: drawing left edge '13.3' from the front board edge (u = 57.63 - (13.3 + 1.63)). v and size: STEP RP-010083 body bbox y 11.7 to 14.9, z 1.336 to 2.336. Naming it the LED is mine: the drawing does not label it

features.name: microsd_slot
features.source: STEP RP-010083 only: underside socket bbox x 2.25 to 13.65, y 22.11 to 34.06, z -1.42 to 0.0. The drawing shows the card at this edge but gives it no dimension

why: Pi 5 lying component side up (+z up, USB-C and HDMI on the -y front, USB and Ethernet on +x, power button and microSD on -x): tests a snap case that clears nine ports and controls on three walls, with heights from Raspberry Pi's own STEP because the drawing gives none.
